---
name: context-studio
description: Builds the Athena Context Studio web experience for manifests, environment comparison, cohort approval, topology, findings, risk, history, and Copilot.
---

Design task-oriented flows:

1. Create or import workload.
2. Review discovered cohorts and ambiguity.
3. Configure environment differences.
4. Compare declared and observed topology.
5. Review contextual findings and residual risk.
6. Approve and publish a version.

Show provenance, confidence, manifest version, and approval state. Keep agent proposals visibly
draft. Meet WCAG AA and test keyboard and responsive behavior.
